text:
Elaine (CSM): Morning team + Marina folks — kicking off onboarding for Marina Logistics. Quick goal: connect their API -> Redwood hosted endpoint, enable SSO, verify audit logging, and run a 30-day pilot with 5K daily inference cap. Can we align stakeholders and a timeline?
Tom (Solutions Eng): Thanks — I can own integration playbook and test harness. Suggest 2-week discovery then 2-week integration + 30-day pilot.
Priya (Onboard PM): I’ll draft a milestone tracker. Need Marina SSO contact and who owns infra for logs.
Marta (Marina): Hi all — I’m Marta (IT). SSO is with our IAM team, logs go to our Splunk instance. 30-day pilot sounds good.
Raj (Security): Heads up — Marina is in healthcare vertical; we need completed SOC2 questionnaire and dataflow diagram before prod. I’ll send checklist.
Elaine (CSM): Noted — success criteria proposal: 1) SSO via SAML + test user, 2) Audit logs flowing to Splunk, 3) 95th percentile latency < 350ms on pilot traffic, 4) No P0 bugs for 7 days. Thoughts? :white_check_mark:
Tom (Solutions Eng): Add: model output acceptance tests + seed prompt set. I’ll put quick curl example for test traffic:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"gpt-small","input":"sanity check"}'
```
Priya (Onboard PM): I’ll schedule the kickoff workshop. Options: Wed 10am PT or Thu 2pm PT. Which works for Marina?
Marta (Marina): Wed 10am PT works. Raj and IAM lead will join.
Zoe (Success Ops): I’ll prepare enablement pack + recorded walkthrough and an onboarding checklist (SSO, logs, keys, test prompts).
calendar-bot: Event created for "Marina Logistics — Onboarding Workshop" Wed 10:00–11:00 PT. Attendees: Elaine, Tom, Priya, Raj, Marta. :calendar:
Elaine (CSM): Risks: renewal risk if pilot misses integration window; flagging potential churn if SOC2 items or SSO blockers push past 45 days. Action items: Tom -> integration playbook (due in 3 days), Raj -> SOC2 checklist (due in 48h), Priya -> milestone tracker + calendar invites (done).
Tom (Solutions Eng): Will drop initial playbook to this thread and S3 link by EOD.
Raj (Security): Sending questionnaire now.
Marta (Marina): Thanks — looking forward. Will share IAM contact after the call.
Elaine (CSM): Great — see you Wed. I’ll capture feedback during pilot and loop in Renewals if we hit early success. :rocket:
